errors.text: The proposed atmospheric tribo-oxidation mechanism is inapplicable to the target molecular-dynamics nanoindentation/friction system, which contains no reactive oxygen environment.

The predicted trend is opposite to the target: it predicts improving wear resistance up to roughly 800–850 °C, whereas the target remains approximately stable only through 600 K and degrades sharply at about 900 K.
The proposed degradation boundary of 850 °C (approximately 1123 K) substantially misses the target boundary of 900 K (approximately 627 °C).
The hypothesis substitutes unrelated alloy compositions and mixed-phase microstructures for the FCC FeNiCrCoCu coating on single-crystal Cu.

It omits the target mediator: temperature-driven lattice disorder, declining dislocation line density, increasing HCP atom fraction, and the transition from stacking-fault-mediated deformation to lattice disorder.
